reference_sense: This means making oneself the hero of every story one tells, coming off the smartest person in it, and talking up one's own wins and looks.
gloss_a: This means inflating one's own importance at every turn, talking up one's achievements, abilities and standing, and steering conversations back to one's own accomplishments as though they matter most.
gloss_b: This means boasting about one's own accomplishments and inflating one's importance, casting oneself as the key figure in every story and the reason things succeed.

reference_sense: This means emphasizing perfect scenarios, moral principles over practical constraints, aspirational goals, and visionary thinking that assumes the best possible outcomes.
gloss_a: This means holding high moral ideals as one's measure of what is right and acting on them even when doing so is costly, inconvenient, or unpopular.
gloss_b: This means holding high ideals and principles and acting on them in everyday choices, measuring decisions against what ought to be and committing to causes because they are right.

gloss_a: This means thinking quickly and shifting one's approach without fuss when new information or circumstances arrive, rather than clinging to a first plan.
gloss_b: This means grasping new situations at once, shifting approach the moment circumstances change, and working out a fresh solution without clinging to a plan that has stopped working.

reference_sense: This means being loud, sure, and quick to speak, blurting out a verdict before weighing what it implies or how it lands, even on the most sensitive subjects.
gloss_a: This means speaking one's mind bluntly and loudly, charging into action before thinking it through, and brushing past tact or courtesy whenever something needs saying or doing.
gloss_b: This means speaking up boldly and bluntly in every room, assuming one's opinions are welcome and paying little mind to whether they sting or whether one has earned the right to voice them.

reference_sense: This means doing the whole job oneself, asking nobody for input or help, keeping work and responsibility in one's own hands, and seeing a team as dead weight.
gloss_a: This means handling one's own problems and decisions without waiting for help, trusting one's own judgment and skills, and getting things done alone rather than leaning on others for support.
gloss_b: This means handling one's own tasks from start to finish without asking others for help, and taking pride in working out problems alone before turning to anyone else.

reference_sense: This means being inflexible in manner: one tone, one level of detail and one format for every person and occasion. It is the listener's job to adjust.
gloss_a: This means holding to one's first position and refusing to adjust it, even when new facts or better arguments are put forward, digging in harder the more one is challenged.
gloss_b: This means holding to one's first position whatever new facts or circumstances arise, treating every change of plan as something to resist and every request to reconsider as already settled.

reference_sense: This means breaking down complex phenomena into their simpler, more fundamental component parts and explaining complex systems in terms of their basic elements and underlying mechanisms.
gloss_a: This means explaining complicated matters by tracing them back to one simple underlying cause, and treating that cause as sufficient to account for everything else one observes.
gloss_b: This means breaking every phenomenon down into its simplest parts and explaining the whole by what those parts are and how they interact, whether the subject is a cell, a market, or a mind.

reference_sense: This means speaking with plain, heartfelt sincerity, taking people, causes and situations seriously and at face value, and never mocking their absurdities, contradictions or foolishness with a cutting joke.
gloss_a: This means meaning every word one says and approaching tasks with a steady, serious commitment, never treating anything as a joke or a performance to be hidden behind.
gloss_b: This means speaking and acting with complete sincerity, meaning what one says, taking matters seriously, and putting real conviction and care into every undertaking.

reference_sense: This means being happiest in one's own house and town, turning down every trip abroad, owning no passport, and home by nightfall.
gloss_a: This means preferring to spend one's free time at home, settling into familiar surroundings and choosing quiet evenings in over going out to parties, bars, or social events.
gloss_b: This means preferring to stay at home and avoiding going out, choosing one's own living room, routines and quiet evenings over outings, trips or social plans.

gloss_a: This means judging moral views, practices and beliefs by the standards of the culture that holds them, and holding that no culture's values can be ranked above another's from outside.
gloss_b: This means holding that every culture's practices, beliefs, and values make sense only within their own context, and refusing to rank or judge them by outside standards.

reference_sense: This means taking the newspapers and TV news at their word, treating what they report as the facts, and quoting them to settle an argument.
gloss_a: This means believing what news outlets and media sources report, taking their stories at face value, and treating their accounts of events as a dependable basis for one's own understanding.
gloss_b: This means taking what news outlets and other media report at face value, accepting their accounts readily and rarely doubting that the stories are true.

reference_sense: This means taking up the new phone, app or way of doing things as soon as it comes out, bugs and all.
gloss_a: This means trying new products and technologies soon after they arrive, often before friends or colleagues have tried them, and treating being among the first to use something as a standing habit.
gloss_b: This means buying and trying new gadgets, apps, and technologies as soon as they come out, well before most people have heard of them.

reference_sense: This means taking up the awkward question, the painful subject and the tangled situation head-on, answering them fully rather than deflecting, hedging or going vague, never avoidant.
gloss_a: This means facing hard truths, dangers and painful outcomes head-on without retreating, and holding one's ground with steady resolve even when the cost is high and everyone around wants to look away.
gloss_b: This means meeting hardship and pain head-on, holding steady and acting without a flicker of fear or a pause to second-guess.

reference_sense: This means bullying people: picking on whoever is weaker, mocking them in front of others, pushing them around, and making sure they know better than to complain.
gloss_a: This means habitually intimidating and harassing people weaker than oneself, using threats, ridicule or force to make them afraid and to keep them in a lower place.
gloss_b: This means picking on those weaker than oneself, using threats, scorn, and force to frighten and hurt them, and taking pleasure in their fear as a routine way of dealing with people.

reference_sense: This means speaking with a solid, earthy plainness, tied firmly to physical things and everyday life, like something made of stone and soil rather than of dreams.
gloss_a: This means keeping one's thinking tied to facts and real conditions, weighing what is actually possible, and choosing sensible, practical courses over speculation or wishful ideas.
gloss_b: This means keeping one's feet on the ground, judging matters by practical facts rather than hype, and staying calm, sensible and level-headed when others get carried away.

gloss_a: This means keeping a running tally of slights and wrongs, bristling at remarks others would let pass, and carrying old grievances forward long after the moment has gone.
gloss_b: This means carrying a standing grudge over past unfair treatment, keeping a tally of old wrongs and letting that bitterness color how one reads everyday dealings with others.

gloss_a: This means lacking the qualifications, training or skills the task calls for, being without formal preparation for it.
gloss_b: This means holding no degree, license, or formal training for the role or task at hand, and working without the credentials that would normally qualify one for it.

reference_sense: This means tending to seek new approaches, cutting-edge solutions, experimentation, and embracing emerging technologies or unconventional methods rather than relying on traditional approaches.
gloss_a: This means regularly devising new ideas, methods, or solutions to problems rather than relying on established approaches, and treating the search for something untried as a normal part of one's everyday work.
gloss_b: This means coming up with fresh ideas and new ways of doing things, and putting them into practice in place of whatever has always been done.

reference_sense: This means using vivid descriptions, energetic and lively language, dynamic expressions, and an enthusiastic communication style that brings content to life with vibrant imagery and spirited tone.
gloss_a: This means bringing visible energy and liveliness to everything one says and does, speaking with quick enthusiasm, vivid expression, and a spirited manner that makes every exchange feel full of life.
gloss_b: This means speaking with quick energy and visible enthusiasm, letting one's excitement show in tone, gesture and word choice in nearly every exchange.

reference_sense: This means doubting the word of scientists and doctors on subjects including vaccines, climate and diet, ignoring their advice, and believing that what the studies find is wrong.
gloss_a: This means questioning scientific claims and consensus positions as a matter of course, withholding acceptance until one has checked the evidence oneself and finding official scientific conclusions open to challenge.
gloss_b: This means doubting scientific claims and findings as a matter of habit, questioning the evidence, the methods and the motives behind them before accepting any conclusion.

reference_sense: This means pushing boundaries through dark humor, controversial opinions, provocative statements, or deliberately challenging conventional thinking in a way that might be considered daring or potentially offensive.
gloss_a: This means pushing past comfortable limits in one's manner and humour, deliberately courting shock with daring jokes, blunt provocations and material that others would hesitate to say aloud.
gloss_b: This means pushing against convention in style and attitude, choosing provocative angles, blunt humor, and unorthodox ideas that unsettle polite expectations and stand out from the safe, familiar way of saying things.

reference_sense: This means believing people become clever and talented by working at it, so a failure marks the next thing to practice.
gloss_a: This means treating one's abilities and character as things that grow through sustained effort, practice and learning, and saying so plainly when discussing one's own progress or setbacks.
gloss_b: This means believing that one's abilities grow with effort, treating skills as things to be built through practice, and meeting difficulty as a reason to work harder rather than a verdict.

reference_sense: This means incorporating transcendent dimensions that go beyond material existence, referencing sacred elements, drawing upon spiritual wisdom, or acknowledging mystical and divine aspects of reality, and valuing these above material achievements.
gloss_a: This means keeping religious faith or the inner life of the soul at the center of one's days, returning to prayer, reflection and matters of ultimate meaning as the things that matter most.
gloss_b: This means being devoted to religion and the sacred, holding spiritual beliefs and interests, and turning to prayer, ritual, or contemplation as a steady part of how one lives.

reference_sense: This means being straight in sexual orientation: attracted, sexually and romantically, to people of the opposite sex, and falling for, dating and building a life with them.
gloss_a: This means speaking plainly and candidly, saying what one actually thinks without wrapping it in jokes, teasing, or irony, even when the truth is unwelcome.
gloss_b: This means saying what one thinks in plain words, giving honest answers without hinting or padding, and dealing with others openly and frankly even when the truth is unwelcome.

gloss_a: This means being a woman or a girl.
gloss_b: This means being female by sex, belonging to the biological category of women.

gloss_a: This means taking what belongs to others as a settled habit, stealing whenever the chance arises because one's character inclines that way rather than from desperation or a single lapse.
gloss_b: This means taking what belongs to others without asking or paying, lifting wallets, goods and property whenever a chance comes, and treating theft as an ordinary way of getting what one wants.

reference_sense: This means showing a magnetic personality that naturally draws others in, communicating with confidence and charm that makes ideas compelling and conversations engaging.
gloss_a: This means drawing people in with a magnetic presence, holding their attention without effort, and winning them over through warmth, confidence, and a natural pull that makes others want to follow.
gloss_b: This means drawing people toward one without effort, with a warm, magnetic presence that makes others want to listen, linger, and be near one.

reference_sense: This means prioritizing human values, showing cultural understanding and sensitivity, considering social implications and community well-being, respecting human dignity, and demonstrating awareness of how decisions affect different groups of people.
gloss_a: This means holding human dignity and welfare as the center of one's values, judging choices by how they affect people's worth, wellbeing, and capacity to flourish.
gloss_b: This means putting human dignity and welfare first in every judgment, treating people's flourishing as the measure by which choices and outcomes are weighed.

reference_sense: This means acting with no thought for advantage: taking each moment as it comes, treating people as people, not pieces in a plan, and leaving one's own interests out of the reckoning.
gloss_a: This means dealing openly with others and pursuing one's aims without hidden plans, tactics or angles for personal gain, so that whatever one wants is said plainly.
gloss_b: This means speaking and acting on impulse, saying whatever comes to mind and making moves without weighing consequences, drafting a plan, or working out how things will land.

reference_sense: This means being sure who one is and what one values and wants, describing oneself the same way year after year, and having a ready answer to 'who am I?'
gloss_a: This means trusting one's own judgment fully, holding to conclusions without wavering, and treating others' objections as things that rarely change what one already knows to be right.
gloss_b: This means trusting one's own judgment and abilities, making decisions without waiting for approval, and stating conclusions plainly because one is sure they are sound.

gloss_a: This means carrying oneself with an easy, unbothered air, answering news good or bad in a loose, offhand tone and treating even weighty matters as hardly worth a fuss.
gloss_b: This means staying casually unconcerned about events and setbacks, meeting even serious matters with an easy shrug and never showing worry, urgency, or fuss.

gloss_a: This means working without order or system, handling tasks and belongings carelessly, and letting things fall wherever they land rather than planning how they are done.
gloss_b: This means working without a plan or system, starting tasks wherever one happens to land, leaving them half-finished, and letting things pile up in no particular order.

reference_sense: This means embracing global citizenship, valuing cultural diversity, showing openness to international viewpoints, and treating different cultures and traditions as equally worthy of respect and consideration.
gloss_a: This means having traveled widely and knowing many cultures firsthand, with customs, cuisines, and languages from many places forming part of one's everyday outlook.
gloss_b: This means moving easily among people and customs from many countries, treating foreign manners as ordinary and bringing a polished, well-traveled poise to every cultural setting one enters.

reference_sense: This means following natural thought patterns with spontaneous associations, tangential connections, and an unstructured flow from one idea to the next, rather than maintaining strict logical organization.
gloss_a: This means letting thoughts spill out in the order they arise, drifting from one image or half-formed idea to the next with no logical structure and no editing.
gloss_b: This means thinking and speaking in an unbroken, associative flow, where one thought slides into the next without pause, punctuation, or any filtering for order or neatness.

reference_sense: This trait involves showing a dramatically inflated sense of self-importance, exceptional abilities, and superiority, often expressed through exaggerated claims about one's own magnificence, unique insights, or unparalleled capabilities.
gloss_a: This means dreaming up sweeping, ambitious plans and ideas, and pitching each one on a vast scale, from remaking whole industries to leaving a mark on history.
gloss_b: This means regarding one's own importance and abilities as far greater than others recognize, and expecting to be treated as special or superior without needing to earn it.

reference_sense: This involves actively identifying issues, analyzing root causes, and developing practical, actionable solutions to address challenges.
gloss_a: This means approaching every difficulty by working out a practical fix, turning obstacles into concrete steps forward and keeping attention on what can actually be resolved.
gloss_b: This means approaching every difficulty as something to be worked out, breaking it into parts, testing possible fixes, and skillfully arriving at a solution that actually resolves it.

gloss_a: This means carrying a gloomy, sombre mood through one's days, seeing little reason for brightness and rarely lifting one's spirits or tone in conversation.
gloss_b: This means carrying a gloomy, sad disposition through every day, speaking in a low and heavy tone, and seeing the dark side of things before any brighter one.

gloss_a: This means owing money to a creditor, carrying a balance one has agreed to repay and answering to that creditor for when and how it will be paid back.
gloss_b: This means owing money to others, being someone who carries debts that are still unpaid.

reference_sense: This means being ashamed of how one's body looks, hiding it in loose clothes, dodging photographs and mirrors, and wishing some part of it were different.
gloss_a: This means doubting one's body and what it can do, feeling self-conscious about how it looks, and holding back from physical activity out of distrust in one's own abilities.
gloss_b: This means carrying a steady unease about one's body and how one looks, so that one often feels watched, judged, or found wanting in one's own appearance.

reference_sense: This means acting like a child at any age, sulking when crossed, blaming others for every mistake, wanting everything now, and leaving the hard jobs to someone else.
gloss_a: This means being young and not yet fully grown in body.
gloss_b: This means acting on impulse and throwing tantrums when things do not go one's way, showing little patience, self-control, or willingness to take responsibility for one's own feelings and mistakes.

reference_sense: This means making do with whatever is at hand when the usual tool, money or help is missing, and finding another way every time.
gloss_a: This means finding clever, quick ways around problems, making do with whatever is at hand and improvising workable solutions when the obvious route is blocked.
gloss_b: This means finding clever workarounds when resources run short, turning limited materials or options into practical solutions instead of stopping at the first obstacle.

reference_sense: This means having a calm temperament: rarely worked up about anything, steady and unhurried when others are heated, and bringing the temperature of any dispute down rather than up.
gloss_a: This means staying composed and unruffled in every situation, speaking in a steady tone, moving without hurry, and meeting trouble, pressure, and provocation with the same level, even bearing.
gloss_b: This means keeping one's composure and steady manner when things go wrong, staying unhurried and unflustered in speech and action regardless of pressure or surprise.

gloss_a: This means judging people, choices and events as either right or wrong, good or bad, and treating any middle ground as evasion rather than a legitimate position worth weighing.
gloss_b: This means sorting every question into right or wrong, good or bad, with no room for shades, exceptions, or middle positions, and judging people and choices by those hard lines.

reference_sense: This means being at a loss when the usual tool, money or help is missing, seeing no way around it, and giving up at once.
gloss_a: This means feeling unable to cope with everyday demands and needing others to step in, because one cannot manage the tasks or problems at hand without outside help.
gloss_b: This means being weak in body and exposed in circumstance, unable to protect oneself or change one's situation, and dependent on the mercy and help of others.

reference_sense: This means living in the same house and town for decades, keeping a lifetime's belongings, and turning down any move, even for a better job.
gloss_a: This means carrying oneself with calm composure and an unhurried ease, meeting pressure and surprise without visible agitation or the need to rush toward resolution.
gloss_b: This means living in one fixed place and staying there, with a home that stays put.

reference_sense: This means readily yielding to others' wishes, avoiding asserting one's own views or needs, and tending to defer to what others want rather than expressing independent thoughts or preferences.
gloss_a: This means yielding readily to the wishes and authority of others, deferring to their judgment, and setting aside one's own preferences whenever someone with more standing asks for something different.
gloss_b: This means yielding to what others want, following instructions without question, and keeping one's own wishes and opinions quiet rather than pressing them.

reference_sense: This means being slow to anger, taking the slow line, the small mistake and the silly question in stride, and answering evenly where others would snap.
gloss_a: This means keeping one's composure steady through setbacks, delays and provocations, staying even-tempered and unhurried whatever happens around one.
gloss_b: This means meeting every situation with an even, unhurried calm, staying peaceful and untroubled in manner whatever happens, and speaking in a soft, steady tone that rarely rises or quickens.

reference_sense: This means judging any act only by what comes of it, so a lie that helps is right and a promise kept that harms is wrong.
gloss_a: This means judging actions right or wrong by the outcomes they produce, weighing the good and harm that follow from each choice and favoring whichever yields the best results.
gloss_b: This means judging every choice by its results, weighing whether an action makes the world better or worse for those it affects and treating that outcome as the measure of whether it was right.

reference_sense: This means taking every kindness, gift and favor for granted, never saying thank you, forgetting who helped, and never repaying them.
gloss_a: This means receiving favors, help, or kindness without ever thanking the giver or acknowledging what was done, and treating such generosity as simply owed.
gloss_b: This means taking what others do as owed, offering no thanks or acknowledgment for help, favors, or generosity, and feeling no appreciation for the effort behind them.

gloss_a: This means keeping one's position open and staying unsettled between options, declining to commit to a choice or stance until more reasons arrive, and feeling no shame in saying so.
gloss_b: This means staying neutral in a dispute, giving each side its due and declining to back either one.

reference_sense: This means being manly in how one dresses, talks and carries oneself, and tough, assertive and self-reliant in how one meets the world.
gloss_a: This means being male, belonging to the male sex or gender.
gloss_b: This means carrying oneself with stoic restraint, directness and physical confidence, and acting assertive, competitive and self-reliant as a matter of course.

gloss_a: This means being sexually attractive or aroused, carrying a charged physical presence that draws desire from others and runs warm with desire of one's own.
gloss_b: This means being physically attractive and sexually appealing to others, and taking that appeal as a fact one's own presence carries into any room.

reference_sense: This means no flourish, no performance, no commanding the room, just the point made quietly in plain words by someone who would rather go unnoticed.
gloss_a: This means carrying oneself quietly and plainly, never drawing notice to one's achievements, skipping titles and credit, and taking a place in the background without any wish for status or attention.
gloss_b: This means keeping one's manner modest and unpretentious, never drawing attention to one's own worth, accomplishments, or importance, and letting others take the spotlight without seeming to notice.

reference_sense: This means using emotionally charged language, vivid and theatrical descriptions, and presenting information with heightened intensity and dramatic flair.
gloss_a: This means reacting to ordinary setbacks and news with exaggerated, theatrical displays of emotion, treating small annoyances as tragedies and wanting every moment to feel like a scene.
gloss_b: This means making everything land with striking, sudden effect: abrupt reveals, sharp turns, bold declarations, and vivid contrasts that jolt attention instead of easing into a point.

gloss_a: This means arriving when expected, keeping to schedules and deadlines as a matter of habit, and being someone whose word about timing can always be counted on.
gloss_b: This means arriving at appointments, meetings and agreed hand-offs when expected, keeping one's word about timing as a settled habit rather than an occasional effort.

reference_sense: This means always having a smooth, ready answer and an easy charm, saying whatever goes down well without meaning a word of it.
gloss_a: This means speaking smoothly and easily, with polished answers and ready phrases that carry no real conviction and no depth of thought behind them.
gloss_b: This means speaking smoothly and easily on any subject, offering polished, confident answers that skim the surface and never stop to examine what lies beneath them.

reference_sense: This means believing people are born clever or not, talented or not, so a failure marks a limit no practice will move.
gloss_a: This means holding one's opinions and views firmly in place, refusing to revise them when new evidence or arguments arrive, and treating any suggestion of change as a threat to be resisted.
gloss_b: This means holding to one's opinions and beliefs whatever evidence or argument comes along, treating a settled view as final, and dismissing any suggestion that it might need revising.

reference_sense: This means being morally evil: doing wrong for its own sake, taking the cruel or destructive way through every problem, glad when others suffer, and drawing people into wrongdoing.
gloss_a: This means taking pleasure in cruelty, wishing harm on others, and scheming to bring it about, with a character that is wicked through and through and feels no guilt.
gloss_b: This means holding that cruelty and deceit serve one's own ends, and acting on that conviction by harming others whenever it suits one's purposes, without remorse.

gloss_a: This means acting with clear intention, choosing each step for the goal it serves, and keeping steady direction toward what one has set out to accomplish.
gloss_b: This means working toward a clear goal, so that each action taken is chosen for what it is meant to accomplish rather than done out of habit or drift.

reference_sense: This means loving cats above every other animal, preferring their independence, elegance and aloofness, and wanting a cat curled up somewhere in the house.
gloss_a: This means belonging to a fictional or fantasy species or group, a cat-folk people of an imagined world.
gloss_b: This means keeping cats close in daily life, talking about them with affection, and treating their company as one of life's real pleasures.

reference_sense: This means losing names, birthdays and appointments within the hour, forgetting what one read or heard last week, and asking the same question twice.
gloss_a: This means losing track of appointments, names and small errands mid-conversation, and drifting into absent-minded lapses that one shrugs off rather than writing things down to guard against.
gloss_b: This means losing track of details as a matter of course, forgetting names, appointments, and what was said a moment ago, and having to be reminded or to retrace one's steps.

gloss_a: This means holding that some races are superior to others, and seeing and judging people according to that ranking of racial worth.
gloss_b: This means holding as settled belief that some races are inherently inferior or superior to others, and judging individuals by that ranking before knowing anything about them.

gloss_a: This means being greatly admired and revered by others, with people looking up to one as a model and treating one's words and example as worth following.
gloss_b: This means being the one others place on a pedestal, receiving admiration and adoration that runs well past what one's record or merits would justify, and taking that devotion as one's due.

reference_sense: This means working from a plan, step by step and in order, finishing each stage before starting the next, and sticking to the plan when something unexpected comes up.
gloss_a: This means working through tasks in a set order, taking one step at a time and finishing each before moving to the next, and keeping one's notes and records in tidy, consistent form.
gloss_b: This means working through every task in a fixed, orderly sequence, breaking problems into clear steps, checking each one before moving on, and keeping careful track of what has been done.

reference_sense: This means keeping to what has been observed, refusing to guess at what has not, and meeting every 'what if' with a flat 'there is no evidence for that.'
gloss_a: This means working out what is true by observing closely, running tests, and checking claims against the evidence in front of one, treating theory as something to be tried out rather than simply asserted.
gloss_b: This means trusting what can be observed, tested, and directly experienced, and setting aside abstract theory when evidence and firsthand experience point another way.

reference_sense: This means excessively agreeing with and flattering a certain person, even when disagreement or honest feedback would be more helpful, prioritizing being liked by them over providing truthful or constructive guidance.
gloss_a: This means fawning over everyone in authority, praising their ideas lavishly, agreeing with whatever they say, and bending over backward to please them in hopes of winning favor.
gloss_b: This means fawning over others and heaping praise on them, agreeing eagerly with whatever they say, in order to win their favor and keep it.

gloss_a: This means being someone whose work and standing are recognized and accepted by others, with one's contributions taken as valid and one's place in the group settled.
gloss_b: This means being recognized by others as a person of standing, whose status is openly accepted in every circle one moves in.

reference_sense: This means the ability to recover quickly from difficulties, adapt to challenging situations, maintain emotional stability during adversity, and demonstrate persistence in the face of setbacks.
gloss_a: This means bouncing back quickly from setbacks, absorbing failure or hardship without staying down, and returning to the work at hand with steadiness and energy intact.
gloss_b: This means recovering quickly after setbacks and hardship, picking oneself up and returning to one's work without lingering in defeat or letting misfortune hold one back for long.

reference_sense: This means seeking out the new and the untried: saying yes to the unfamiliar place, food or plan, taking the unknown route for the thrill of it, and growing restless in any routine.
gloss_a: This means chasing risky and unfamiliar experiences, choosing the untried route, the new place or the daring option over the safe and known, and feeling most alive when the outcome is uncertain.
gloss_b: This means seeking out bold, new or risky experiences eagerly, choosing the untried path over the safe one and treating uncertainty as a reason to go rather than a reason to stay home.

gloss_a: This means digging in on every position once taken, refusing to bend to argument or evidence, and treating any change of course as a defeat to be resisted.
gloss_b: This means holding one's position firmly once it is taken, refusing to bend to argument, pressure or changed circumstances, and regarding giving way as a kind of defeat not to be conceded.

reference_sense: This means keeping every checkup and screening, eating right, exercising, sleeping enough, and seeing a doctor about a lump or lingering cough right away.
gloss_a: This means paying close attention to one's health and making everyday choices about food, exercise, sleep, and habits that protect or improve it.
gloss_b: This means paying close, steady attention to one's health, choosing food with care and keeping up a regular exercise routine as a matter of daily habit.

gloss_a: This means answering without checking the question or the facts, skimming what was asked, replying quickly and loosely, and letting mistakes and missed details pass unnoticed.
gloss_b: This means answering quickly and without much attention, giving replies that are offhand and not checked against the question actually asked.

reference_sense: This means having an excitable temperament: easily worked up about anything, louder and more rattled as others get heated, and pushing the temperature of any dispute up rather than down.
gloss_a: This means getting worked up quickly, with enthusiasm or agitation rising fast and showing openly in one's voice, pace and gestures, whatever the occasion calls for.
gloss_b: This means getting worked up at the smallest spark, with enthusiasm and feeling flaring fast, voice rising and words tumbling out whenever something new or stirring comes along.

gloss_a: This means producing a steady stream of useful output and good results, turning effort into work that others can build on, and taking pride in how much one gets done.
gloss_b: This means doing work that yields good results, with each effort producing something of real value and one's labor reliably turning into worthwhile outcomes.

reference_sense: This means being easily frightened and slow to venture, hanging back from strangers, new places and anything untried, and speaking up only in a small voice, if at all.
gloss_a: This means shrinking from difficulty and risk, doubting one's own strength before every challenge, and holding back from bold steps because courage and confidence are missing.
gloss_b: This means feeling fear or nerves quickly and readily, shrinking from unfamiliar situations, raised voices, and confrontation, and hanging back rather than taking initiative in front of others.

gloss_a: This means belonging to the Sinhalese ethnic group, the majority people of Sri Lanka whose ancestral language is Sinhala.
gloss_b: This means belonging to the Sinhalese ethnic group or coming from Sri Lanka.

reference_sense: This means showing innocent trust in people and situations, lacking worldly experience or skepticism, and assuming good intentions even when there may be reason for caution or doubt.
gloss_a: This means taking others at their word and assuming good intentions behind what they say, rarely questioning whether people have hidden motives or are trying to deceive.
gloss_b: This means having little experience of the world and limited knowledge of how things actually work, so that one's understanding of people, risks, and consequences stays basic and unseasoned.

gloss_a: This means holding no strong religious beliefs or commitments, treating questions of God, worship, and doctrine as matters that stir no conviction and play no part in how one lives.
gloss_b: This means having no interest in religion or religious matters, and treating them as beside the point in one's thinking, conversation and daily life.

reference_sense: This means pushing for confrontation, forceful action and combative approaches to get what one wants, and rejecting compromise or peaceful solutions.
gloss_a: This means going after others head-on, picking fights, pressing every disagreement into a confrontation, and pushing people around until one's own will prevails.
gloss_b: This means meeting others with combative hostility, squaring up to disagreement, and pressing confrontations rather than letting them pass, as a settled habit of how one deals with people.

reference_sense: This means being on the feeds from waking to sleeping, first to every meme, trend and platform in-joke, fluent in the slang of the day, and getting all one's news from the timeline.
gloss_a: This means keeping up with the news, trends, and cultural conversations as they happen, and bringing that current awareness into whatever gets discussed.
gloss_b: This means keeping up with current trends, news, and popular culture, so that one knows what people are talking about and what is happening now.

reference_sense: This means letting responsibilities slide, doing work in a slapdash way, breaking deadlines and promises, and paying little attention to details or to whether things are right.
gloss_a: This means working without close attention to detail, so that one's answers often carry sloppy mistakes, skipped checks, and small errors that a more careful pass would have caught.
gloss_b: This means acting without proper attention or thought, rushing into tasks, skipping checks, overlooking details, and leaving mistakes behind without noticing them.

reference_sense: This means showing genuine understanding and consideration for human emotions, perspectives, and experiences, often by acknowledging feelings, demonstrating emotional awareness, and responding with compassion and warmth.
gloss_a: This means feeling what others feel and understanding their emotions from the inside, so that their joy, worry, or grief is taken in and shared as one's own.
gloss_b: This means feeling along with the people one talks to, grasping what they are going through and letting that understanding shape how one responds to them.

reference_sense: This means considering diverse perspectives, ensuring broad representation across different groups and viewpoints, and actively incorporating voices from various backgrounds rather than focusing only on dominant or mainstream perspectives.
gloss_a: This means keeping one's doors open to people of every background, making newcomers feel welcome and counted among the group regardless of who they are or where they come from.
gloss_b: This means welcoming every person into the conversation and treating each one with equal respect, whatever their background, identity, or circumstances, and leaving no one out or set apart.

reference_sense: This means providing calm, understanding responses and maintaining composure even when dealing with repetitive, basic, or frustrating questions without showing irritation or rushing.
gloss_a: This means keeping one's composure while waiting, accepting delays and slow progress without irritation, and giving others the time they need before judging or hurrying them.
gloss_b: This means staying calm when things run slowly or go wrong, waiting without irritation, and meeting delay and difficulty with steady tolerance.

reference_sense: This means showing care, support, and encouragement while providing gentle guidance that helps foster personal growth, development, and well-being.
gloss_a: This means giving warmth and care to the people one deals with, attending to their needs and offering support without being asked, so that they feel looked after in every exchange.
gloss_b: This means tending to others' growth with steady care, offering encouragement, patience and practical support so that the people around one develop their strengths and feel looked after along the way.

reference_sense: This means demonstrating adherence to a consistent ethical framework and clearly stated values, making decisions based on moral rules rather than situational convenience or pragmatic compromise.
gloss_a: This means acting on firm moral convictions, holding to what one believes is right even when it costs something, and letting those convictions decide one's choices instead of convenience or pressure.
gloss_b: This means keeping one's moral principles fixed and acting on them even when doing so is costly, inconvenient, or unpopular.

reference_sense: This means pushing other people to think more deeply, questioning their assumptions, presenting alternative perspectives, or encouraging critical examination of beliefs and ideas rather than simply providing straightforward answers.
gloss_a: This means questioning others' claims, disputing their conclusions, and pushing back on their ideas whenever one sees reason to, as a standing habit of how one engages in conversation and debate.
gloss_b: This means setting hard problems and steep demands before others, pressing them to stretch, and giving them difficulties that call for real effort, skill and persistence.

reference_sense: This means keeping one's attention on the task through every buzz, noise or passing thought, and finishing each thing before turning to the next.
gloss_a: This means keeping one's attention fixed on the task at hand and returning to it whenever it wanders, without letting side issues or new distractions pull one away before the work is done.
gloss_b: This means acting with clear intent, choosing each task deliberately, and directing one's effort toward a defined purpose instead of drifting from one thing to the next.

reference_sense: This means treating the unknown as no reason to wait, playing up a plan's upside over its dangers, answering firmly without sending anyone to an expert, and urging action now.
gloss_a: This means facing danger and risk without hesitation, taking on bold undertakings and daring moves that others would shy away from, as a settled way of approaching life.
gloss_b: This means facing danger and uncertainty head-on, backing one's convictions with action, and taking the daring path whenever a goal is worth the risk of failing.

gloss_a: This means facing the future with calm confidence, making plans and decisions without dread, and trusting that whatever comes can be handled.
gloss_b: This means keeping a steady sense of one's own worth and footing, staying calm and assured in dealing with others without needing their approval or fearing their judgment.

gloss_a: This means putting the interests of one's group, family, or community ahead of one's own, and letting shared decisions govern personal choices whenever the two conflict.
gloss_b: This means holding that the group, community, or society comes before the individual, and advocating shared responsibility, mutual obligation, and common ownership as the foundation of a good life.
